title: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six

abstractEnglish: We prove that every smooth connected complex projective Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous, resolving the Campana–Peternell conjecture in complex dimension six. As a consequence, a connected compact Kähler manifold X with nef holomorphic tangent bundle and $`\dim_{\mathbb C}X-\widetilde q(X)\leq6`$ has ordinary universal cover $`F\times\mathbb C^{\widetilde q(X)}`$, where F is a rational homogeneous manifold and $`\widetilde q(X)`$ is the maximal irregularity of a connected finite étale cover.
titleEn: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six

details.overview: 该稿件研究复射影Fano流形在切丛为nef时的结构问题。作者声称证明了：每个光滑连通复射影Fano六维流形若切丛nef，则是有理齐性流形，从而在复维数六解决Campana–Peternell猜想。摘要还给出推论：满足nef全纯切丛且复维数减最大不规则度不超过6的紧Kähler流形，其普通万有覆盖为有理齐性流形与复环面的乘积。意义在于把该猜想推进到六维并给出Kähler情形推论，但尚未经独立审查。
keyPoints: 作者声称证明六维光滑Fano流形切丛nef即有理齐性，解决该维数猜想。
推论涉及nef切丛紧Kähler流形，万有覆盖分解为有理齐性流形与复环面乘积。
